Trace plan for VirtualMachine demo/web-04
  node:          worker-3
  launcher pod:  virt-launcher-web-04-7hq2x (uid 1a6d1f0e-0000-4000-8000-000000000003)
  events:        drops,tcp,interfaces for 45s
  address:       10.244.3.40 (default, pod)

Save the plan with --file (or -o json) to use it on the node.

On node worker-3, as root (netdoctor does not deploy anything):
  kubectl-netdoctor host trace --plan PLAN.json --file trace.json
Then:
  kubectl netdoctor diagnose vm/web-04 -n demo --trace trace.json
